rationale: Execution-verified against Airflow 3.2: the current pins (google 8, cncf-kubernetes 7) do not install. google's first AF3.2-capable major is 16 (8-15 fail to resolve/install), and cncf-kubernetes needs 9+ (7/8 fail to import); any google 16-22 with cncf-kubernetes 9-10 installs cleanly, so bumping to the latest (google 22, cncf-kubernetes 10) is correct.
